newsitem.title: FRANCE: No decision yet on French carmaker aid - PM office.
newsitem.headline: No decision yet on French carmaker aid - PM office.

text.p: The French government is studying a request from carmakers Renault and PSA Peugeot-Citroen for state aid to finance a large early retirement plan but has not yet made a decision, a member of Prime Minister Alain Juppe's staff said on Friday.
"We're still studying the case, we don't yet have all the details," the official said. "A decision has not yet been taken."
The official was responding to a report in the European Wall Street Journal that quoted unnamed government officials saying the support was unlikely.

"It's politically abominable," the paper quoted a finance ministry official as saying about the plan, which involves the early retirement of about 40,000 workers from the two carmakers and the hiring of about 14,000 younger, cheaper workers to replace them.
